name: Jayatma Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1955, Jayatma Industries Ltd manufactures and trades cotton like Kapas, ginning cotton bales, raw oil, and its agro products, byproducts, and yarn.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
JIL is engaged in cotton ginning and pressing, along with trading of raw cotton, ginned cotton bales, cotton yarn, and cotton seeds. It also manufactures wash oil (raw oil) and de-oiled cakes (DOC). Recently, the company has diversified into manufacturing technical textile products such as Geogrids high-strength polymer structures used in civil engineering for soil reinforcement and stability in roads, retaining walls, and embankments.
